htmlLang.how: The create-next-app root layout writes <html lang="en">; change it in that JSX.
htmlLang.note: The template writes it, not the framework; no App Router setting.

title.how: Export metadata = { title } or generateMetadata() from a layout or page.
title.note: The starter ships a placeholder, "Create Next App".

description.how: The description field of the metadata export.

contentInHtml.how: App Router pages are server components, prerendered or server-rendered.

openGraph.how: The openGraph field of metadata, or an opengraph-image file.

skipLink.how: Written by hand in the root layout.

csp.how: The policy string written by hand, sent from headers() in next.config or proxy.ts.
csp.note: The framework adds its nonce to its own scripts when a policy carries one.

frameOptions.how: X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors added by hand in headers().

sitemap.how: An app/sitemap.ts file that lists the URLs.
sitemap.note: The URLs are listed by the developer, not taken from the routes.

jsonLd.how: A <script type="application/ld+json"> rendered by hand, escaped by the developer.
